targets.adjudication_verdict: GENUINE FINDING, UNSOUND CRITERION. The self-route label is accurate and the substantive conclusion is established -- but by the recorded pairwise distances and the NON-GATING cr_ratio(h) sweep, not by C1. ITEM 1's direct actions= channel produces real per-action divergence at the E1 output on a trained model (ON arms 1.46e-03 to 2.19e-03 mean pairwise L2, both seeds, both ON arms, with genuine per-pair structure), and cr_ratio(h=1) moves 4.14e-07/4.05e-07 -> 2.67e-03..3.96e-03 (6455x-9775x) while remaining 25-37x short of the 0.1 bar; e1coe_score_var stays 5-7 orders below 0.002. C1 itself is unsound: A_off's ten pairwise distances are EXACTLY 0.0 in both seeds (the OFF branch of predict_long_horizon never reads actions, and Phase 4c holds total_curr bitwise fixed with a hidden-state reset per call), so the control's DV is analytically pinned to zero; C1 divides instead by contrast_ratio = 1.03e-08/2.69e-08, which is pure float32 rounding residue in the mean-and-subtract (reproduced independently: five bitwise-identical float32 vectors of the observed norm give cr ~1.8e-08). Consequences verified by execution: (i) the headline measured 57809.12 vs threshold 6.101 is ON divided by rounding residue and is not an effect size; (ii) LIFT_FACTOR = max(3.0, 2.0 x (1.4966e-07/4.906e-08)) = 6.101 derives the run's proudest defence against inherited constants from the ratio of two rounding errors; (iii) had the mean rounded exactly, off_ratio == 0 -> rel_lift = NaN -> rel_ok = False -> all four cells fail -> status FAIL on a substrate that works, so the PASS/FAIL boundary is decided by float32 jitter in both directions. The 936a both-tails guard did not close this because abs_lift is itself denominated on OFF (2x residue); only ABS_ACTION_CR_FLOOR = 1e-7 is truly absolute, and it sits ~10x above the residue rather than at any level tied to E2's 2.8e-2 reference. All three tails collapse to 'is the ON contrast ratio above 1e-7?' -- a wiring check. That question was genuinely at risk (954's red-team localised a ~675x LSTM+output_proj crush that could have swallowed the direct channel), so C1 is NOT unfailable-by-construction; what it cannot do is measure the 'material lift toward E2's trained per-action reference' its statement claims, since no tail references that reference.

learning_extracted: A control arm pinned analytically to zero is excellent probe hygiene and a useless ratio denominator. The same design property that proves the isolation is clean (bitwise-identical inputs -> bitwise-identical outputs) destroys the denominator of any ratio criterion built on it. When a control is zero by construction, gate on an absolute reference, never on ON/OFF.

'Derived from this run's own measured baseline' is only a defence when the baseline measures something. The idiom is a genuine guard against inherited constants and was applied here in good faith -- but applied to float32 residue it launders noise into a threshold. Check the derived-from quantity has a physical interpretation before crediting the derivation.

A criterion whose verdict flips on rounding is unsound even when it happens to give the right answer: V3-EXQ-965 would have reported FAIL had the residue rounded to zero. Sound-in-substance is not sound-in-mechanism, and only the second survives a different machine or dtype.

Attribution launders authorship. The driver cited its acceptance criterion and its Phase-4c protocol to a design doc containing neither (the quoted text traces to the V3-EXQ-954 driver docstring and to substrate_queue.json's implementation_hint), which made a self-authored bar read as pre-registered and stopped it being audited. Quote-check provenance claims against the cited artifact.

A partially-applied autopsy handoff is invisible to the standing scans: GOV-APPLY-1 covers the claim side only, nothing audits whether recommended_substrate_queue_entry was applied, and an already-true 'change' tail can clear a claim row whose other recommendations were dropped. Both failure modes are instantiated on this one lineage.
